title: Larger popups — should they match Settings and small dialogs?

steps.path: Larger header above an independently scrolling detail body
steps.hint: Scroll inside each overlay to see its content reach the header and bottom. Scroll outside it to reach the next version. Try Meadow Mist, Halftone Dimension and a solid theme; choose Other if the edge needs tuning.
steps.headline: Should larger project-detail popups get this same divider and content fade?
steps.risk: The 42px fade softens the edge but makes the last visible lines faint until you scroll further. This preview changes no production styling and does not cover Tags or Marketplace.
